learning.title: Offer the fix in place when a user is blocked by something they may fix
learning.trigger: A form, composer or action is refused because a prerequisite is missing, and the user could supply it (access, a setting, a connection).
learning.mistake: Refused with a message and sent the user elsewhere to fix it, losing their draft and intent.
learning.rule: Offer the fix inline to people allowed to do it, say what it will do and the least-privilege default, keep the draft and place, confirm and offer undo, audit it; others see who can; one pattern wherever the block occurs.

verification.requirement: A spec that refuses without permission, grants with it, and keeps the draft.
